summary: Most requested frontend features appear implemented: new Landing Page at "/" with a Daily Top 3 Parlay module, new searchable Prop Board table with Value Bar and actions, updated routing, parlay max-6 enforcement, combined hit-rate utility, and a reusable per-pick Show Logic component. However, some acceptance-criteria details are not clearly satisfied from the diff summary (notably graceful <3-pick messaging and certain UI displays), and there is evidence of unrequested admin/provider-key configuration work in Settings.

missing_requirements.requirement: If fewer than 3 edge opportunities exist, the "Daily Top 3 Parlay" module degrades gracefully with a clear empty-state message in English.
missing_requirements.reason: LandingPage always slices to up to 3 picks, but DailyTopParlay only shows an empty-state when edges.length===0; no message is shown when 1–2 picks exist (i.e., fewer than 3).

missing_requirements.requirement: The existing Edge Board/prop discovery view remains accessible under a stable, clearly named route and is linked in the header navigation.
missing_requirements.reason: A stable route for the existing Edge Board is added as "/board", but the header navigation shown only links to "/" (Home), "/props" (Prop Board), "/parlay", "/settings", and "/about"—no link to "/board" is present.

missing_requirements.requirement: When 2–6 legs are selected, the Parlay Builder displays a "Projected combined hit-rate" percentage (and does not show a misleading combined hit-rate when <2 legs).
missing_requirements.reason: A combined hit-rate calculator utility is added and invoked in ParlayBuilderPage, but the diff excerpt is truncated before any UI output that actually displays the "Projected combined hit-rate" value, so the display portion of the requirement is not verifiable from the provided diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Each pick displayed in the Prop Board table includes a "Show Logic" control that expands/collapses additional details.
missing_requirements.reason: PropBoardPage imports ShowLogic, but the diff excerpt is truncated before the table row rendering is fully shown; the presence of the control per row is therefore not verifiable from the provided diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Each leg displayed on the Parlay Builder page includes a "Show Logic" control that expands/collapses additional details.
missing_requirements.reason: ParlayBuilderPage imports ShowLogic and constructs a mock edge object, but the diff excerpt is truncated before confirming that <ShowLogic .../> is rendered for each leg.

hallucinated_features.description: Admin-only API configuration form/provider key management added to Settings page.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest explicitly lists admin/provider configuration flows as non-goals, but the diff summary states Settings includes an "admin-only API configuration form for provider keys".
